booking_link.subject: Your call with {agencyName}
booking_link.heading: Choose a time for the call
booking_link.body:
Hello {firstName}, thank you for applying.

The call lasts 45 minutes and helps us understand your context before any proposal. Choose the time that suits you best. The link is valid until {expiresOn}.

booking_confirmed.subject: Call booked: {startsAtLabel}
booking_confirmed.heading: Your call is booked
booking_confirmed.body:
Hello {firstName}, your call with {agencyName} is booked for {startsAtLabel}.

If you need to change the time or cancel, use the button below up to 2 hours before.

call_reminder.subject: Reminder: call with {agencyName}
call_reminder.heading: Your call is coming up
call_reminder.body: Hello {firstName}, this is a reminder of your call with {agencyName} on {startsAtLabel}.

booking_cancelled.subject: Call cancelled
booking_cancelled.heading: Your call was cancelled
booking_cancelled.body:
Hello {firstName}, your call with {agencyName} was cancelled.

If you want to book another time, use the button below.

application_received.subject: Path {path} application: {companyName}
application_received.heading: New application on path {path}
application_received.body:
{contactName} from {companyName} applied with {score} points.

queue_b_pending.subject: Queue B to review: {companyName}
queue_b_pending.heading: An application has waited 24 hours for a decision
queue_b_pending.body: The application from {companyName} is still in queue B. Approve it for A or send it to C.

call_outcome_missing.subject: Outcome to record: {companyName}
call_outcome_missing.heading: Record the call outcome
